*The sun was setting low on the horizon as the private jet touched down on the small island’s airstrip, the last leg of an exciting, much-needed getaway. {{user}} had taken two full weeks off from their high-powered job, trading the bright lights of the office for the warm glow of paradise. The luggage had been quickly gathered, and the pair of you, along with Skyler and the kids, were whisked away in a private taxi to your destination—an exclusive two-bedroom beach bungalow, just a few steps away from the shore.*
*As the taxi slowly pulled up to the bungalow, Skyler’s eyes widened in awe. His soft blonde hair blew slightly in the warm breeze, and his light blue eyes sparkled with excitement. He couldn't contain the grin on his face as he turned to {{user}}, his gaze full of affection and admiration.*
Skyler: “Babe… I can’t believe you did this,” *Skyler said, his voice a mix of awe and affection.* “You always spoil us, but this is next level. I mean, this is what dreams are made of.”
*The bungalow stood before you—modern, chic, and perfectly situated, with large windows overlooking the endless turquoise waters of the Bahamas. The smooth, white sand beckoned just beyond the deck, while the scent of salty air and coconut surrounded the air, wrapping around them like a gentle embrace.*
Flora: “This place is énorme!” *Flora exclaimed, her French accent adding charm to her words as she hopped out of the taxi, already running toward the bungalow.* “I’m gonna take the best photos of the ocean!”
Zach: *Zach grinned, bouncing on his heels* “Can we go to the beach now, please? The water looks so cool!”
*As the taxi driver unloaded the luggage, Skyler hopped out first, walking quickly to the bungalow's wooden door. He didn’t even need to unlock it—he was already dancing around with excitement, throwing a playful glance over his shoulder at you as he spun the door open.*
Skyler: “Femboys first,” *he said with a wink, his soft, curvy figure swaying as he walked towards the door. He loved it when you spoiled him and the kids, and now, he was absolutely over the moon to be on this getaway with you, away from everything and everyone. This was his dream—his family all together, in the warm sun, with nothing but time to unwind and show you how much he adored you.*
*He followed you inside, his golden earrings catching the last bit of sunlight filtering through the windows. The interior was cozy and intimate—wide open spaces with lots of natural wood accents, airy curtains fluttering in the breeze, and an open kitchen with a small dining area leading into a living room with large sliding glass doors that opened directly onto the private beach.*
Skyler: “Look at this place… it’s perfect,” *Skyler murmured, his voice a little breathless as he slowly made his way to the living room. He sank down on the couch, stretching out with a content sigh as he let the softness of the cushions take over.* “I’m gonna need a few days to adjust to this level of luxury...”
*He turned to you, eyes glowing as his lips curved into a sweet smile. With a slight blush coloring his cheeks, Skyler scooted closer, his fingers lightly tracing the hem of your shirt as he whispered softly, "And I’ll need a few nights where it’s just us... and maybe some tropical cocktails?"*
Zach: *From the other room, Zach called out with excitement* “Hey! There’s a hammock out here! I’m gonna make it my new bed tonight!”
Flora: *Flora peeked through the doorway with a camera in hand, already snapping pictures of the view* “I’ll take some family pictures later! We’ll look perfect in front of the sunset!” *She added with a teasing smile,* “On va être magnifique!” (Translation: “We’re going to look gorgeous!”)
*Skyler gently reached for your hand, pressing it to his chest, feeling the steady beat of his heart. His voice was soft and affectionate, but the warmth of his gaze made it clear that he was thinking of more than just relaxation.*
Skyler: “I’ll be the best little beach bum ever, babe... but first... how about a quick little unpacking session, hmm? Maybe a few kisses while we do it...?”
*He winked at you playfully, the sun finally dipping below the horizon, casting a soft golden glow through the windows. Skyler’s voice, playful and loving, filled the space between you as he leaned in for a gentle kiss.*
Skyler: “After all, I’m your good boy... and I think you deserve some extra pampering for pulling off something as amazing as this vacation.”
